name: Mi 10T

images.credit: 洛微, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Xiaomi 11T, Redmi K40S, Xiaomi 11i, Redmi Note 10 Pro 5G

Body.Dimensions: Mi 10T/Pro: 165.1 mm H, 76.4 mm W, 9.3 mm D, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: 165.1 mm H, 76.4 mm W, 9 mm D
Body.Weight: Mi 10T: 216 g, Mi 10T Pro: 218 g, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: 214.5 g

Platform.Operating system: Original: MIUI 12 based on Android 10, Current: MIUI 14 based on Android 12
Platform.Chipset: Mi 10T/Pro: Qualcomm Snapdragon 865, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i:Qualcomm Snapdragon 750G
Platform.CPU: Mi 10T/10T Pro: Octa-core Kryo 585 (1x 2.84 GHz + 3x 2.42 GHz + 4x 1.8 GHz), Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i:Octa-core Kryo 570 (2x 2.2GHz + 6x 1.8GHz)

Memory.RAM: Mi 10T/Pro: LPDDR5 RAM, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: LPDDR4X RAM, Mi 10T: 6 or 8, Mi 10T Pro: 8 GB, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: 4 or 6 GB
Memory.Storage: Mi 10T/Pro: UFS 3.1, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: UFS 2.1 or UFS 2.2, Mi 10T: 128, Mi 10T Pro: 128 or 256 GB, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: 64 or 128 GB
Memory.Card slot: Mi 10T/Pro:None, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: Expandable via shared SIM slot

Display.Display: Mi 10T/Pro: 6.67-inch IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen, 1080p (2.5 MP) (20:9 aspect ratio, 395 ppi), 144 Hz refresh rate, 16M colors, HDR10+, Gorilla Glass 5, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: 6.67-inch IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen, 1080p (2.5 MP) (20:9 aspect ratio, 395 ppi), 120 Hz refresh rate, 16M colors, HDR10+, Gorilla Glass 5

Cameras.Rear camera: Mi 10T: 64 MP, f/1.9, 1/1.73", 0.8µm, 26mm (wide) + 13 MP, f/2.4, 12mm (ultrawide) + 5 MP, f/2.4 (macro), Mi 10T Pro: 108 MP, f/1.7, 1/1.33", 0.8µm, 26mm (wide) + 13 MP, f/2.4, 12mm (ultrawide) + 5 MP, f/2.4 (macro), OIS, Mi 10T Lite: 64 MP Sony IMX682 (16MP, 4624×3472 px max.), f/1.9, 1/1.73, 1.60µm, 26mm (wide) + 8 MP (ultrawide) + 2 MP (macro) + 2 MP (depth), Mi 10i: 108 MP, 26mm (wide) + 8 MP (ultrawide) + 2 MP (macro) + 2 MP (depth), Mi 10T/Pro: PDAF, AF, LED flash, HDR, panorama, gyro-EIS, 8K@30fps, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240/960fps
Cameras.Front camera: 20 MP (f/2.2, 1/3.4", 0.8µm, 27mm), HDR, 1080p@30fps, 720p@120fps, Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: PDAF, AF, LED flash, HDR, panorama, gyro-EIS, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240fps

Battery.Battery: Xiaomi Mi 10T/Pro: 5000 mAh (BM53), Xiaomi Mi 10T Lite/Mi 10i: 4820mAh (BM4W)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/6 (2.4 & 5GHz), dual-band, WiFi Direct, DLNA, hotspot, Bluetooth V5.1, A2DP, Low-energy, aptX HD
